name: Wat Phra Mahathat Woramahawihan, Nakhon Si Thammarat
description: Wat Phra Mahathat Woramahawihan is a vast Buddhist monastery in Nakhon Si Thammarat, southern Thailand, set on a narrow strip of land between two oceans. Its towering stupa, built in the early 13th century, is said to hold a relic of the Buddha. Each year worshippers wrap it in long cloths, and Nora dance dramas still keep the site's ancient traditions alive.
